_meta.subject: Ticketing/issue-management architecture — generalize the binary file-vs-git backend seam (ADR-0002) shared by scribe's bug-report/feature/issue skills into a 3-way backend choice (local / git / external), and add push-mode entry (watch + triage + trust gate) for backends where external actors can file items nobody in this workspace typed
prior_art: ADR-0002 — git-native execution ruling (Issues as work-item canon, PRs as merge gate) — the existing binary backend precedent this generalizes
doc-authoring-standards' Phase-0 backend seam, shared verbatim by scribe's bug-report/feature/issue skills
the issue skill's Phase 2 shape-routing (defect -> bug-report, feature idea -> feature, generic remainder -> task) — reused by the triage classifier
orchestration's loop-design (autonomous continuation patterns: /goal, /loop, Stop hooks) — the mechanism the watch loop is built from
the 2026-07-17 /scribe:issue seed asking for an AskUserQuestion-driven repo setup: polling or MCP watch, known-friendly auto-accept, unknown-author approval growing an allow-list

nodes.label: ticketing/issue-management system (cross-plugin: scribe capture skills + forge entry-file ruling + orchestration watch loop)
backend adapter layer
local-file adapter (docs/tickets/ TICKET files via doc-forge)
git-native adapter (gh issue / PR)
external adapter interface (Linear/Jira/Notion/custom via MCP or REST) — a typed contract; concrete third-party implementations are repo-specific and out of this pack's scope
backend resolver — reads the repo's entry-file ruling and returns the active adapter to any caller
repo configuration (one-time setup)
backend chooser — AskUserQuestion: Option A (local) / B (git) / C (external)
entry-mode chooser — pull-only vs watch-enabled (offered only when backend is B or C) plus, when watch is chosen, the watch mechanism (polling interval vs MCP subscription)
ruling writer — persists the backend + entry-mode choice into the entry file (CLAUDE.md routing-table row, ADR-0002-style) plus any adapter/watch config
on-demand capture (existing: bug-report/feature/issue skills)
capture skills' Phase 0-4 logic — mint or resume a record via the resolved backend adapter; existing behavior, only its Phase-0 backend-selection call changes from the binary check to the resolver
watch/triage (relevant only when entry-mode = watch, backend B/C)
watch loop — poll or MCP-subscribe for newly filed issues/PRs against the active backend
triage classifier — reuses the issue skill's Phase-2 shape routing (defect/feature/task) on an externally-filed item
dispatcher — on a classified, trust-cleared item, invokes n3a non-interactively to mint/resume the record
trust gate
friendlies store — durable allow-list of trusted filing accounts
trust check — looks up a filing author against n5a
approval flow — surfaces an unknown author's item to a human for approve/deny

actions.label: choose the backend for a repo, once (Option A/B/C)
choose the entry mode for a repo, once (pull-only vs watch-enabled), offered only for non-local backends
persist both choices, plus any watch config, into the entry file so they're discoverable and durable
resolve the active backend adapter at runtime for any caller
create a record in the active backend
search/dedup existing records in the active backend before minting
update an existing record (fold new detail, advance status)
capture an item and mint/resume its record, whether triggered by a human/agent invocation or by the dispatcher
watch the active backend for newly filed issues/PRs (poll or MCP-subscribe)
classify an incoming externally-filed item's shape (defect/feature/task)
check whether the filing author is a known friendly
auto-route a trusted author's item straight into capture, no human gate
hold an untrusted author's item for human review
let a human approve or deny a held item
on approval, add the author to the durable friendlies allow-list
choose the watch mechanism (polling interval vs MCP subscription) when entry mode is watch-enabled

edges.why: entry-mode is only offered once the backend choice determines it's non-local
the resolver reads the ruling n2c persists into the entry file
capture skills' Phase-0 call switches from the binary check to the resolver; the resolver must exist first
the watch loop consumes the entry-mode + mechanism choice n2b captures
the dispatcher routes on the classifier's shape output
the dispatcher only auto-routes after a trust-check result exists
the dispatcher hands a cleared item to capture's existing mint/resume logic
the approval flow only receives items the trust check marked unknown
an approval decision is what grows the friendlies allow-list; the store's write path depends on the approval flow producing a verdict
